messages.subject: Corporate Affairs Executive | Government Relations, ESG & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear PLBsearch Team,

Your boutique executive-search focus across communications, public affairs and senior corporate leadership aligns closely with my international profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where reputation, policy, institutional trust and responsible development are central to performance. I am internationally mobile and open to senior cross-border appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
